observation:
Tier 1 Orchestrator exhibited dual critical blunders upon initialization:
1. Premature Whole-Suite Test Run: Executed un-targeted `bun test` across 8,590 tests (785 files, ~200s runtime) at Turn 1 before constructing any task topology or dispatching subagents, surfacing 28 unrelated failures and wasting compute.
2. Supervisor Direct Code Edits: Spawned ZERO subagents and directly edited 7 repository files in its own supervisory thread (`types.ts`, `base-collector.ts`, `collectors/antigravity.ts`, `collectors/claude.ts`, `collectors/openai.ts`, fixtures) in direct violation of SUPERVISOR_ZERO_CODE_EDITS.
remediation:
1. Turn 1 Planning & Dispatch Invariant: Turn 1 is strictly reserved for charter decomposition, disjoint write scope partitioning, and 1-shot batch subagent dispatch (0 test commands allowed at Turn 1).
2. Strict Supervisor Zero-Code-Edits: Supervisors must NEVER write, edit, or touch repository source files directly; all changes must be executed by leased Tier 3 Implementers.
3. Implementer-Owned File-Scoped Testing: Implementers own 100% of targeted unit testing (`bun test <path.test.ts>`).
4. Final Door Only (Pre-Push): Whole-suite test execution is permitted only at the final release door prior to git commit if the completeness critic has not already run it.
